messages:
Leah M.: kicking off rollout of fp16-optimize-v1 to ap-southeast-1 — ramp 5% -> 40% over 10m. please watch embeddings p99 and request queue depth.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release/fp16-optimize-v1 @ ap-southeast-1. change-window 02:00-04:00 UTC. progressing to 5% (5/100). :rocket:
Tom K.: seeing p99 for embeddings climb to ~1.1s at t+3m, overall 5xx still low but queue depth trending up.
Carlos R.: could be batching/serializer mismatch with fp16 path. any kvcache miss rate spikes?
Priya: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/ap-southeast-1/rollouts?panel=embed_qdepth — kvcache_miss_rate panel shows a small uptick.
alert-bot: Alert (notice): embeddings-p99 > 900ms sustained 2m at 6801234598. Severity: notice.
Leah M.: hold ramp. set rollback threshold to 1% 5xx or p99 > 1.5s for 3m. fallback is fp16-optimize-v0 pinned.
Tom K.: running a quick canary tweak: reduce batch.max_tokens from 2048 -> 1024 on canary workers to lower queue head-of-line.
Carlos R.: prefer applying `--set batching.dynamic=true` on canary first; reduces small-batch tail.
Tom K.: applying canary config change: `deploy-orch apply --env ap-southeast-1 --filter canary --set batching.dynamic=true`
deploy-bot: Canary config change applied. re-evaluating. traffic remains at 5%.
alert-bot: Update: embeddings-p99 dropped to 420ms at 6801234615 after canary config change. queue depth stabilized.
Priya: recording in release notes: https://confluence.redwood/releases/fp16-optimize-v1 — note about dynamic batching flag and canary-only change.
Leah M.: hold at 5% for 15m. if stable, continue ramp to 40% in 10m increments. if any regression, rollback to fp16-optimize-v0 and pin heavy-traffic customers to Dedicated pools.
Tom K.: action items: 1) perf sweep with short/long sequence mixes on fp16-optimize-v1 2) add dynamic-batching toggle to runbook 3) prepare rollback blurb for release notes.
Carlos R.: I'll add kvcache miss and batching.* metrics to the embed SLO dashboard.
Leah M.: thanks. keeping thread open, will mark complete once 40% stable for 20m. post any anomalies here. :thumbsup:
